title: Projected Neural Differential Equations for Learning Constrained Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2410.23667v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural differential equations offer a powerful approach for learning dynamical systems from data. However, they do not inherently respect known constraints, such as conservation laws, that should be obeyed by the learned dynamics. It is well known that enforcing constraints in data-driven models can enhance their generalizability and numerical stability. In this paper, we introduce projected neural differential equations (PNDEs), a method for constraining neural differential equations based on projection of the predicted velocities onto the tangent space of the manifold that fulfills the constraint. In tests on several examples from different fields, including chaotic dynamical systems and power grid models, PNDEs outperform existing methods for constraining learned dynamics, require fewer hyperparameters, and are computationally more efficient. translated_title: 用于学习受约束动力学的投影神经微分方程
translated_abstract: 神经微分方程为从数据中学习动力系统提供了一种强大的方法。然而，它们本身并不能遵循已知的约束条件，例如学习到的动力学应当遵守的守恒定律。众所周知，在数据驱动模型中强制施加约束能够提升模型的泛化能力和数值稳定性。本文提出了投影神经微分方程（PNDEs），这是一种通过将预测速度投影到满足约束的流形的切空间上来约束神经微分方程的方法。在来自不同领域的多个实例（包括混沌动力系统和电网模型）的测试中，PNDEs优于现有的约束学习方法，所需超参数更少，且计算效率更高。该方法展示了增强受约束动力学建模的潜力。
tldr: 本文提出投影神经微分方程（PNDEs），通过将预测速度投影到约束流形的切空间上来强制满足物理约束，在混沌系统和电网模型等测试中比现有方法表现更优、所需超参数更少且计算效率更高。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces projected neural differential equations (PNDEs), which enforce known constraints by projecting predicted velocities onto the tangent space of the constraint manifold, outperforming existing constraining methods with fewer hyperparameters and greater computational efficiency on tests including chaotic dynamical systems and power grid models.
